summary.text: Tuan Le is the Republican candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 40 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat RaShon Young.
Le is an engineer and entrepreneur who previously ran for the seat in a 2025 special election and for Florida's 10th Congressional District in the 2024 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Tuan Le earned a high school diploma from Evans High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Central Florida in 2006, and a graduate degree from Strayer University in 2015.
His career experience includes working as an engineer and entrepreneur, according to Ballotpedia.
In the 2024 Republican primary for U.S. House Florida District 10, Le lost to Willie Montague, 46.5% to 53.5%.
Le was the Republican nominee in the September 2, 2025, special general election for Florida House District 40, which RaShon Young won with 75.1% of the vote to Le's 24.9%.
